mentions.name: Grit Garden
mentions.description: Personal art project that turns daily Wordle attempts into gritty, struggle-filled stories echoing the emotional arc of Wordle gameplay. Users can upload their own Wordle game screenshot to generate their own story, built with vision models and prompt fine-tuning.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Grit Garden: https://grit.garden (https://github.com/pravj/wordle-garden)

Recently shipped this personal art project that turns daily Wordle attempts into gritty / struggle-filled stories, kinda similar to the emotional arc of the Wordle game play.

You can upload your own Wordle game screenshot to generate one for yourself.
